title: One shared craft book: what a session learns in one repo, the next repo starts with
why: Owner, Nov 1 21:02 CST: "even broader than this, it's like if i learned how to build seomthing better one way, i should be able to utilize that again some other day" Just how a carpenter gets more skilled with his experience, similarly we should too, rather than always being a new laborer in each repo!". Grep found no home for lessons today (only decision guard-guards-mistakes-only mentions one).
note: One shared craft book in claude-settings, by topic (testing, CI, merging and batches, guards and checks, UI and design, records and prose, orchestration). Each entry: one "do this" line, the evidence that earned it (repo, PR or incident), and where it applies. Feed: every lane's closing report names its lessons (zero is fine); a harvester (triage or the lane close step) folds each into the book, or into the skill that owns the topic (one home per capability). Reuse: a session loads the topics its task touches before it plans, by path or by task. Measure: a lesson that repeats as a new incident counts as a miss. Step test-practices-first-principles becomes its testing chapter. Source: coordinator Nov 1 21:20 CST. Port: yes, every repo. Ready; placed high in order.
